newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Bank shares down due to worries over sector.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Bank shares down due to worries over sector.

text.p: Shares in Fuji Bank Ltd dropped in heavy volume on Wednesday morning due to worries over bad loan problems afflicting much of the financial sector, brokers said.

The share price of the Japanese city bank was down 30 yen at 1,640 yen at 0136 GMT, after briefly falling as low as 1,620 yen. Its volume was 1.87 million, the sixth largest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
"Shares in Fuji Bank, as well as other banks, were dragged down by lingering worries over bad loan problems," said a trader at a major Japanese securities house.

A broker said that the recent sharp plunge in the benchmark Nikkei stock average reignited worries that banks' latent profits would shrink as a result of the decline in the value of their shareholdings.
